observation.command: for u in "https://pnpm.io/next/cli/install" "https://pnpm.io/npmrc#minimum-release-age" "https://pnpm.io/next/npmrc" "https://pnpm.io/npmrc"; do echo "=== $u ==="; curl -sL --max-time 40 "$u" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g' | grep -iB2 -A6 "minimum-release-age\|minimumReleaseAge" | head -40; done
